cells.docstring: Mounts and levels a vibration-isolated OpticalBench handle at the given rack_id and reference wavelength_nm.
Locks a reference laser cavity mode onto a mounted OpticalBench and returns a LockedCavity.
Arms the electro-optic phase modulator bank driven by a LockedCavity and returns a ModulatorBank.
Sweeps the armed ModulatorBank over span_pm picometers to capture a raw FringeStack interferogram.
Resolves 2pi phase discontinuities and branch-cut residues in a FringeStack, producing an unwrapped PhaseField.
Fits a Zernike polynomial wavefront aberration model onto an unwrapped PhaseField.
Exports a calibrated WavefrontModel to a binary .ael phase lookup-table file on disk.
Measures instantaneous mechanical thermal drift of a mounted OpticalBench in nanometers.
Computes Michelson visibility and SNR contrast metrics from a captured FringeStack.
Safely parks pneumatic isolators and shuts down a mounted OpticalBench.
Re-stabilizes the shroud housing on a LockedCavity at target_k Kelvin.
Dumps raw uncalibrated FringeStack frames to a .csv text file (does not fit Zernike models or produce .ael LUTs).
DEPRECATED v1.x pneumatic mount returning LegacyBench (incompatible with v2.x lock_reference_laser and measure_bench_drift).
Computes wrapped preview CoarseEstimate directly from FringeStack without unwrapping residues (rejected by solve_zernike_wavefront).
Performs open-loop service alignment on an OpticalBench without locking cavity phase, returning BenchDraft (incompatible with arm_phase_modulator).
